units.rawText: I step into the Lab. I've seen the ruined interior so many times that it doesn't even raise a ripple in my heart anymore.
units.displayText: I step into the Lab. I've seen the ruined interior so many times that it doesn't even raise a ripple in my heart anymore.

spans.text: I step into the Lab. I've seen the ruined interior so many times that it doesn't even raise a ripple in my heart anymore.

units.rawText: I start up the D-Mail apparatus as quickly as I could. Several minutes later, the familiar electrical arcs are crackling in front of me again.
units.displayText: I start up the D-Mail apparatus as quickly as I could. Several minutes later, the familiar electrical arcs are crackling in front of me again.

spans.text: I start up the D-Mail apparatus as quickly as I could. Several minutes later, the familiar electrical arcs are crackling in front of me again.

units.rawText: Alright, now for the contents of the D-Mail!
units.displayText: Alright, now for the contents of the D-Mail!

spans.text: Alright, now for the contents of the D-Mail!

units.rawText: I start with the D-Mail to have Riko cancel the shipment. If the source of the Entropic attack really is inside Riko's shipment, this ought to stop the Entropization.
units.displayText: I start with the D-Mail to have Riko cancel the shipment. If the source of the Entropic attack really is inside Riko's shipment, this ought to stop the Entropization.

spans.text: I start with the D-Mail to have Riko cancel the shipment. If the source of the Entropic attack really is inside Riko's shipment, this ought to stop the Entropization.

units.rawText: I enter "Riko's shipment is bad. Cancel it" into the message field and then press the Send button.
units.displayText: I enter "Riko's shipment is bad. Cancel it" into the message field and then press the Send button.

spans.text: I enter "Riko's shipment is bad. Cancel it" into the message field and then press the Send button.

units.rawText: However... Nothing happens.
units.displayText: However... Nothing happens.

spans.text: However... Nothing happens.

units.rawText: Reading Steiner does not activate like it did before.
units.displayText: Reading Steiner does not activate like it did before.

spans.text: Reading Steiner does not activate like it did before.

units.rawText: ...As I thought, the problem won't be solved so easily.
units.displayText: ...As I thought, the problem won't be solved so easily.

spans.text: ...As I thought, the problem won't be solved so easily.

units.rawText: In that case, I'd better tell the Professor that Lukako broke the Oasis' security sensor. That way, the battle won't be as bad as it is now.
units.displayText: In that case, I'd better tell the Professor that Lukako broke the Oasis' security sensor. That way, the battle won't be as bad as it is now.

spans.text: In that case, I'd better tell the Professor that Lukako broke the Oasis' security sensor. That way, the battle won't be as bad as it is now.

units.rawText: I changed the recipient on the computer to the Professor. Now for the message content...
units.displayText: I changed the recipient on the computer to the Professor. Now for the message content...

spans.text: I changed the recipient on the computer to the Professor. Now for the message content...

units.rawText: Tap, tap—
units.displayText: Tap, tap—

spans.text: Tap, tap—

units.rawText: A strange, yet rhythmic sound comes from the stairs. It's coming closer and closer to the Lab.
units.displayText: A strange, yet rhythmic sound comes from the stairs. It's coming closer and closer to the Lab.

spans.text: A strange, yet rhythmic sound comes from the stairs. It's coming closer and closer to the Lab.

units.rawText: Are those... footsteps?
units.displayText: Are those... footsteps?

spans.text: Are those... footsteps?

units.rawText: ...Mayuri? Mayuri, is that you?
units.displayText: ...Mayuri? Mayuri, is that you?

spans.text: ...Mayuri? Mayuri, is that you?

units.rawText: I reflexively turn to open the door to take a look.
units.displayText: I reflexively turn to open the door to take a look.

spans.text: I reflexively turn to open the door to take a look.

units.rawText: Right before I touch the handle, I suddenly sense something is off.
units.displayText: Right before I touch the handle, I suddenly sense something is off.

spans.text: Right before I touch the handle, I suddenly sense something is off.

units.rawText: —It's too quiet.
units.displayText: —It's too quiet.

spans.text: —It's too quiet.

units.rawText: At some point, the sounds of gunfire and the roars of the Entropics have vanished.
units.displayText: At some point, the sounds of gunfire and the roars of the Entropics have vanished.

spans.text: At some point, the sounds of gunfire and the roars of the Entropics have vanished.

units.rawText: A strange yet rhythmic sound comes from the stairs. It's moving closer and closer to the Lab.
units.displayText: A strange yet rhythmic sound comes from the stairs. It's moving closer and closer to the Lab.

spans.text: A strange yet rhythmic sound comes from the stairs. It's moving closer and closer to the Lab.

units.rawText: That's why the sounds of footsteps are so distinct, how they so easily caught my attention.
units.displayText: That's why the sounds of footsteps are so distinct, how they so easily caught my attention.

spans.text: That's why the sounds of footsteps are so distinct, how they so easily caught my attention.

units.rawText: Tap.
units.displayText: Tap.

spans.text: Tap.

units.rawText: The footsteps stop at the doorway. My fingertips are so numb that I'm sure that there's no way I can finish the D-Mail before the other party opens the door.
units.displayText: The footsteps stop at the doorway. My fingertips are so numb that I'm sure that there's no way I can finish the D-Mail before the other party opens the door.

spans.text: The footsteps stop at the doorway. My fingertips are so numb that I'm sure that there's no way I can finish the D-Mail before the other party opens the door.

units.rawText: Just then, I notice a nearby pile of stuff, the collection of the fruits of the Lab's wisdom.
units.displayText: Just then, I notice a nearby pile of stuff, the collection of the fruits of the Lab's wisdom.

spans.text: Just then, I notice a nearby pile of stuff, the collection of the fruits of the Lab's wisdom.

units.rawText: That's right! If I use that...!
units.displayText: That's right! If I use that...!

spans.text: That's right! If I use that...!

units.rawText: Right at that moment, the door before me is cut in half by some external force.
units.displayText: Right at that moment, the door before me is cut in half by some external force.

spans.text: Right at that moment, the door before me is cut in half by some external force.

units.rawText: Take this!
units.displayText: Take this!

spans.text: Take this!

units.rawText: I hit the switch on Future Gadget No. 004, "Moad Snake".
units.displayText: I hit the switch on Future Gadget No. 004, "Moad Snake".

spans.text: I hit the switch on Future Gadget No. 004, "Moad Snake".

units.rawText: Although it's basically nothing more than an instant humidifier that only runs for a few seconds, it's just enough to buy me some time.
units.displayText: Although it's basically nothing more than an instant humidifier that only runs for a few seconds, it's just enough to buy me some time.

spans.text: Although it's basically nothing more than an instant humidifier that only runs for a few seconds, it's just enough to buy me some time.

units.rawText: White mist instantly fills my vision.
units.displayText: White mist instantly fills my vision.

spans.text: White mist instantly fills my vision.

units.rawText: Just then, the activated PhoneWave (name subject to change) finally begins arcing.
units.displayText: Just then, the activated PhoneWave (name subject to change) finally begins arcing.

spans.text: Just then, the activated PhoneWave (name subject to change) finally begins arcing.

units.rawText: The electrical currents dance through the room, announcing my victory.
units.displayText: The electrical currents dance through the room, announcing my victory.

spans.text: The electrical currents dance through the room, announcing my victory.

units.rawText: Muhahahaha! You're too late!
units.displayText: Muhahahaha! You're too late!

spans.text: Muhahahaha! You're too late!

units.rawText: I look at the silhouette before me.
units.displayText: I look at the silhouette before me.

spans.text: I look at the silhouette before me.

units.rawText: My instincts tell me that the person standing before me right now is the culprit behind all of this.
units.displayText: My instincts tell me that the person standing before me right now is the culprit behind all of this.

spans.text: My instincts tell me that the person standing before me right now is the culprit behind all of this.

units.rawText: Even though their face is hidden by the heavy mist, I can still make out the bared teeth on its face.
units.displayText: Even though their face is hidden by the heavy mist, I can still make out the bared teeth on its face.

spans.text: Even though their face is hidden by the heavy mist, I can still make out the bared teeth on its face.

units.rawText: The likes of you will never be able to... stop... me—
units.displayText: The likes of you will never be able to... stop... me—

spans.text: The likes of you will never be able to... stop... me—

units.rawText: I get a clear look at what the black figure is dragging behind it.
units.displayText: I get a clear look at what the black figure is dragging behind it.

spans.text: I get a clear look at what the black figure is dragging behind it.

units.rawText: <size=40><color=red>...Ma...yuri?</color></size>
units.displayText: ...Ma...yuri?

spans.text: ...Ma...yuri?

units.rawText: As the girl hears my voice, she slowly opens her eyes.
units.displayText: As the girl hears my voice, she slowly opens her eyes.

spans.text: As the girl hears my voice, she slowly opens her eyes.

units.rawText: Blood spills from her mouth.
units.displayText: Blood spills from her mouth.

spans.text: Blood spills from her mouth.

units.rawText: It is only then that I notice that her throat has been ripped away, leaving only a yawning black void in its place.
units.displayText: It is only then that I notice that her throat has been ripped away, leaving only a yawning black void in its place.

spans.text: It is only then that I notice that her throat has been ripped away, leaving only a yawning black void in its place.

units.rawText: Even so, the girl's lips are still opening and closing.
units.displayText: Even so, the girl's lips are still opening and closing.

spans.text: Even so, the girl's lips are still opening and closing.

units.rawText: <size=60><color=red>"Run away", "run away", "run away."</color></size>
units.displayText: "Run away", "run away", "run away."

spans.text: "Run away", "run away", "run away."

units.rawText: No conscious thought went into forming these words. She is mouthing them out of pure instinct.
units.displayText: No conscious thought went into forming these words. She is mouthing them out of pure instinct.

spans.text: No conscious thought went into forming these words. She is mouthing them out of pure instinct.

units.rawText: <size=60><color=red>AAAHHHHHHHHH!</color></size>
units.displayText: AAAHHHHHHHHH!

spans.text: AAAHHHHHHHHH!

units.rawText: Murderous bloodlust seizes control of my body.
units.displayText: Murderous bloodlust seizes control of my body.

spans.text: Murderous bloodlust seizes control of my body.

units.rawText: But all I can do right now is press the Send button—
units.displayText: But all I can do right now is press the Send button—

spans.text: But all I can do right now is press the Send button—

units.rawText: My consciousness fades along with the world before me, leaving nothing but endless rage and regret in its wake.
units.displayText: My consciousness fades along with the world before me, leaving nothing but endless rage and regret in its wake.

spans.text: My consciousness fades along with the world before me, leaving nothing but endless rage and regret in its wake.
